description: Budget management platform for service businesses. This file is the durable feature queue for the multi-agent harness.

features.name: harness_bootstrap
features.title: Bootstrap multi-agent harness
features.description: Add the repository harness inspired by betta-tech/ejemplo-harness-subagentes and adapt it to Bambu System.
acceptance: AGENTS.md acts as the progressive-disclosure map for agents
feature_list.json tracks one feature at a time with valid statuses
progress/current.md and progress/history.md persist session state
docs/architecture.md, docs/conventions.md, and docs/verification.md define project-specific standards
CHECKPOINTS.md gives reviewers objective final-state criteria
.codex/agents contains leader, implementer, and reviewer roles
init.ps1/init.sh run harness validation plus repository checks

features.name: codex_subagents
features.title: Replace Claude harness entrypoint with Codex subagents
features.description: Remove CLAUDE.md and make Codex subagent profiles the required orchestration roles.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md is removed because Codex reads AGENTS.md directly
.codex/agents contains leader, implementer, and reviewer profiles
Harness validation requires .codex/agents instead of Claude-specific files
No repository harness files reference Claude-specific entrypoints

features.name: budget_authorization_contracts
features.title: Harden budget ownership and category authorization
features.description: Refactor budgets and budget categories so reads and mutations enforce authenticated ownership or admin contracts before later UI work.
acceptance: getBudgets, getBudgetBySlug, getBudgetById, duplicate, update, and delete only expose or mutate budgets owned by the authenticated user
Budget mutations call auth() first, validate input with schemas, verify ownership before writing, and return consistent { error } results
BudgetCategory actions are explicitly admin-only through requireAdminSession() or converted to a documented user-owned model
Budget create/update/delete flows have no debug console.log statements
Manual smoke covers budget list, detail, create, edit, duplicate, delete, and budget categories

features.name: settings_server_action_auth
features.title: Secure settings server actions
features.description: Make settings mutations derive identity from the authenticated session instead of trusting client-sent user ids.
acceptance: updateName, updateEmail, updatePassword, enable2FA, disable2FA, and updateProfileImage call auth() and do not trust a client-provided user id
Account, email, password, 2FA, and profile image inputs validate through schemas/settings.ts
Settings actions are split by account and security responsibility with read helpers kept separate from mutations
The settings page keeps a server-side shell where viable and scopes client components to forms, dialogs, or interactive controls
Manual smoke covers account updates, email or password changes, profile image updates, and 2FA enable or disable flows

features.name: runtime_lazy_sdk_initialization
features.title: Lazy initialize runtime SDK clients
features.description: Move OpenAI, Resend, Cloudinary, and runtime URL configuration out of module scope so Next.js build and runtime contexts load safely.
acceptance: OpenAI, Resend, and Cloudinary clients are created through lazy getters or one-time configuration helpers
Environment variables and base URLs are read close to use and fail with clear errors when required values are missing
The AI chat streaming route imports domain helpers and keeps route-handler logic focused on request parsing, auth, and streaming response
No runtime SDK performs network-client initialization solely because a module was imported
Verification includes init.ps1 and pnpm build when the environment permits, plus focused smoke for affected AI, email, or upload paths

features.name: platform_dependency_patch_review
features.title: Review and patch Next and React dependencies
features.description: Run a controlled platform upgrade for Next.js, React, and React DOM to patched compatible versions.
acceptance: Next.js, React, and React DOM target versions are checked against the current patched release line before editing package files
package.json and the lockfile are updated together with no unrelated dependency churn
Any migration notes or breaking changes are documented in progress/current.md or a feature report
Verification includes init.ps1 and pnpm build when environment variables permit
Manual smoke covers auth, dashboard navigation, and AI chat after the upgrade

features.name: ai_chat_modularization
features.title: Split AI chat UI, streaming, history, and upload responsibilities
features.description: Reduce the AI chat monolith by moving chat state, history, image upload, rendering, and server message construction into focused modules.
acceptance: AIChat.tsx is reduced to a small shell or orchestrator under the repository file-size guidance
Session state, history, and image upload live in focused hooks that can be reasoned about independently
Message list, input, history panel, and chat actions are separate components with clear props
OpenAI client access and chat message construction live in server/domain helpers while the stream route stays thin
BudgetContext coupling is isolated behind an adapter instead of being buried throughout reusable UI
Manual smoke covers streaming, abort or error handling, image upload, save history, rename, and delete

features.name: budget_form_and_cache_refactor
features.title: Refactor budget forms, filters, preview, and query cache
features.description: Split the budget create/edit flow into focused sections and centralize filter parsing, query keys, invalidation, and domain helpers.
acceptance: Budget query keys and invalidation helpers are centralized for budgets and budget categories
Budget list filter parsing and URL/query-state handling live in focused filter helpers or hooks
Create and edit flows share a BudgetFormShell where behavior overlaps
Details, labor or time, contributions, costs or products, price, and preview are separated into focused form sections
Slug, option, and ownership helper logic lives under lib/budgets or an equivalent scoped domain location
Authored budget form files stay under 200 lines unless an exception is explicitly justified
Manual smoke covers create, edit, duplicate, delete, category selection, preview, and filtering

features.name: ops_occurrence_scheduling_refactor
features.title: Separate ops occurrence reads, generation, and scheduling UI
features.description: Make job occurrence reads and generation commands explicit, split the occurrence dialog and scheduling helpers by responsibility, and improve measured Visits loading under the current infrastructure.
acceptance: getJobOccurrences is strictly read-only and occurrence generation or persistence is moved behind an explicitly named idempotent command
Occurrence generation, persistence, employees, and recurrence math have clear module ownership
JobOccurrenceDialog is split into dialog shell, form, form state, and submit helpers where useful
Jobs and employees required by JobOccurrenceDialog load on demand instead of during every Visits page load

Three equivalent authenticated Visits loads are measured under the same infrastructure and the main-content median is at most 4 seconds, or the remaining external bottleneck is documented with evidence
Scheduling-related authored files stay under 200 lines unless an exception is explicitly justified
Manual smoke covers monthly calendar load, create visit, edit visit, split occurrence, and archive flows

features.name: ops_finance_domain_refactor
features.title: Unify operational finance management and monthly rules
features.description: Create a unified Finance workspace for client payments, operational costs, and employee payments while centralizing shared summaries and assigned-month rules.
acceptance: The operations nav replaces Cobros, Costes, and Pagos with one Finanzas entry at /dashboard/financial while the three legacy routes remain functional
Finance shows one monthly recorded-only summary plus independently filtered sections for client payments, operational costs, and employee payments
Finance supports create, edit, void, payroll suggestions, employee attribution, cost categories, and BPS settings without leaving the page
Employee payments have a required assigned month, existing rows are backfilled from paymentDate, and financial screens use it without double-counting cross-month work periods
Monthly summary, payment status, and assigned-month logic live under lib/ops/finance and are reused by dashboard, costs, payroll, and Finance
Loading, empty, error, retry, responsive UI, focused calculations, lint, build when available, and authenticated browser smoke are recorded

features.name: client_boundaries_and_cleanup
features.title: Reduce client-heavy pages and clean cross-cutting debug debt
features.description: Push client components lower where practical and remove remaining debug logging, generic errors, and inconsistent cache/action wrapper patterns.
acceptance: Full-page use client boundaries in budgets and settings are reduced where server components can own the shell safely
Non-productive console.log statements are removed from budget, form-hook, dropdown, and user-data paths
Action wrappers touched by the refactor throw or return typed errors consistently with local patterns
Any intentionally client-heavy page documents the reason in the feature progress report
Verification includes init.ps1 and manual smoke for each affected route

features.name: budget_hourly_target_product_margin
features.title: Add hourly price targeting and optional product margin
features.description: Let budget authors target a total or hourly service selling price, derive the required service margin, disable product margin by default, and compare hourly prices with and without products.
acceptance: Create and edit forms expose a numeric service hourly-price target that derives the service revenue percentage
Create and edit forms expose a total service price target that derives the hourly target from total hours
Targets below the service cost per hour clamp to zero service margin
Product margin is disabled by default and products remain billed at cost when disabled
Product margin can be enabled at the existing 15 percent default and persists through create and edit
The live preview shows hourly prices both without and with products, excluding IVA
Focused calculation checks, lint, build when available, and browser smoke are recorded

features.name: budget_recent_searches
features.title: Remember recent budget searches
features.description: Persist and expose the five most recent budget search terms in the browser.
acceptance: Non-empty budget searches are saved in localStorage
At most five unique searches are kept in most-recent-first order
Recent searches appear from the budget search input and can be selected to search again
Lint and a browser smoke check pass

features.name: calendar_operational_filters
features.title: Filter the operational calendar
features.description: Let users narrow the monthly calendar and daily agenda by job, employee, visit status, and visits that need attention.
acceptance: The calendar can be filtered by job and employee using options from the loaded month
Users can additionally filter by visit status or show only visits that need attention
Job, employee, status, and attention filters compose over the same visible result set
Calendar markers, monthly metrics, and the selected-day agenda reflect the filtered visits
Active filters are summarized and can be cleared together
The empty state explains when filters hide all visits and offers a reset action
Lint and a browser smoke check pass

features.name: job_budget_option_net_price
features.title: Show budget option prices without IVA when creating jobs
features.description: Display the net price for each linked budget option in the job form instead of the stored IVA-inclusive price.
acceptance: The budget option selector displays each option price without IVA
The selected option summary uses the same net amount and labels it as excluding IVA
The change reuses shared job budget pricing rules
Focused calculation checks, lint, and a browser smoke check pass

features.name: job_excel_export
features.title: Export filtered jobs to Excel
features.description: Add a jobs-page export that downloads the jobs matching the current filters with linked price, hourly price, and relevant operational details.
acceptance: The jobs page exposes a clear Excel export button with pending and error feedback
The export contains exactly the jobs matching the current search, status, visibility, and archived filters
When archived jobs are excluded, records with archived status or an archived date are both omitted
Linked job price reuses the shared snapshot-aware IVA pricing rule and hourly price is derived from the option workload

The workbook keeps only relevant operational fields, the budget name, product inclusion and included-product price, without status, reference, budget identifiers, pricing internals, archive metadata, audit identities, or technical ids
The workbook is readable in Excel with a styled frozen header, filters, and practical column widths
Focused export checks, lint, build when available, and a browser smoke check are recorded

features.name: visits_multi_view_infinite_history
features.title: Add multi-view visits history with weekly infinite scroll
features.description: Turn the operational calendar into a Visits surface with calendar, compact list, and card views backed by weekly TanStack Query pagination.
acceptance: The dashboard navigation and calendar route present the operational surface as Visits while retaining the monthly calendar and agenda
Users can switch between Calendar, List, and Cards, with Calendar as the first default and the last selected mode persisted locally
List and Cards share a newest-first weekly infinite query that loads older matching visits without duplicate requests
Job, employee including unassigned, status, and attention filters compose consistently across all views and reset when the operational month changes
Filter options are available independently of the weeks already loaded and visit-related mutations invalidate the infinite feed safely
Initial loading, another-week loading, retryable error, empty result, and end-of-history states are explicit
Focused boundary checks, TypeScript, lint, build when available, and authenticated browser smoke are recorded

features.name: job_profitability_alerts
features.title: Alert on service losses and material profit shortfalls
features.description: Compare budget snapshots with attributable operational costs and surface severity-aware profitability alerts across the operational workspace.
acceptance: Profitability uses budget revenue and profit without IVA, completed-visit labor and transportation, and recorded job-linked operational costs without treating collection timing as profitability
Positive projected profit more than 20 percent below target, losses up to 10 percent of expected revenue, larger critical losses, and incomplete data have distinct reusable states
The operational dashboard shows the highest-priority monthly alerts and a compact healthy state
Finance shows the complete searchable and severity-filterable monthly profitability view
Jobs show profitability badges and an attention filter while job detail shows monthly and historical breakdowns
Profitability queries are batch-oriented, authenticated, cached, and invalidated after relevant operational mutations
Focused calculations, TypeScript, lint, build when available, and authenticated responsive browser smoke are recorded

features.name: shared_mail_ai_agent
features.title: Add a shared inbox with an AI reply agent
features.description: Add an admin-only shared Hostinger mailbox workspace that drafts replies with OpenAI, learns through approved memory, and can safely automate confirmed similar messages.
acceptance: The admin-only /dashboard/email workspace provides thread search and filters, Inbox, Sent, and Archive views, read or unread and archive controls, compose, reply, reply-all, forward, and attachment handling without becoming a full webmail

A resumable three-month IMAP import and bounded incremental sync exclude Spam, Trash, and Drafts, deduplicate messages, use leases, expose a manual refresh, and support a bearer-protected cron-job.org trigger every 15 minutes on Vercel Hobby

SMTP delivery records auditable outbound state and appends sent mail to Hostinger Sent; attachments are capped at 4 MB total, larger files fall back to Hostinger metadata and handoff, and attachment messages never enter AI or automatic-send workflows

OpenAI Responses uses gpt-5.6-luna with structured xhigh-effort triage and drafting, keeps complex replies manual, sends store false and a stable safety identifier, and fails clearly when configuration is missing

Approved historical replies and administrator-approved memory provide retrieval context; extracted memories remain pending until approved and feedback records accepted, edited, rejected, and manually sent outcomes

Administrators can confirm, pause, and remove similar-message automation rules; exact or semantic matching, Luna intent and safety gates, protected literals, known-sender and recipient restrictions, business-hour queuing, cancellation on follow-up, and a master switch prevent unsafe sends

The initial automatic-send master switch is off, all sync, draft, review, rule, queue, send, failure, and cancellation events are auditable, and loading, empty, retryable error, responsive, authorization, focused checks, lint, build, migration, and authenticated browser evidence are recorded

features.name: official_budget_versioning
features.title: Version official budgets from generator snapshots
features.description: Create a shared official-budget domain that publishes immutable, auditable versions from the existing budget generator without reusing mutable BudgetOption rows as commercial sources.
acceptance: OfficialBudget, OfficialBudgetVersion, and version-option persistence is separate from Budget and BudgetOption, uses Decimal for new monetary values, and is delivered through an additive migration
Publishing a generator budget creates version 1 atomically and every later edit of a linked generator budget creates a new immutable version without depending on recreated BudgetOption ids

Each version snapshots every option, including service metadata, frequency, visits, hours, employees, product inclusion, net price, IVA, final price, hourly price, monthly workload, and the internal calculation breakdown needed for audit

Weekly monthly workload uses visits times hours per visit times employees times 4.32; calculated monthly values are labeled as estimates while stored fixed official monthly prices remain authoritative

Archiving an official budget detaches it from the generator while preserving its complete version history, and an actively linked generator budget cannot be deleted through either the action layer or the database contract
Official-budget reads and mutations have explicit server-side authorization, validation, audit metadata, and transaction-safe error handling
Focused snapshot, calculation, versioning, archive, and deletion-guard checks plus Prisma validation, migration verification, TypeScript, lint, and build evidence are recorded

features.name: official_budget_workspace_separation
features.title: Separate official budgets from the budget generator
features.description: Present the current budget builder as Generador de presupuestos and add a distinct official-budget workspace for publishing, reviewing, and archiving commercial price sources.
acceptance: The current /dashboard/budgets surface is labeled Generador de presupuestos without changing its existing calculation and editing purpose

A separate /dashboard/official-budgets surface lists active and archived official budgets with search, source generator, current version, publication date, and clear loading, empty, error, and retry states
Administrators can publish an eligible generator budget, inspect every immutable version and its full option breakdown, and archive or detach an official budget through guarded server actions
Generator list and detail views show a clear official indicator and link while a linked generator budget explains why deletion is unavailable
Official budgets and the generator appear as separate entries in desktop and mobile navigation with unambiguous names and routes
Query keys and invalidation keep generator badges, official lists, versions, publication, edits, and archive state coherent
Focused authorization and state checks, TypeScript, lint, build when available, and authenticated responsive browser smoke are recorded

features.name: mail_official_budget_search_and_sources
features.title: Ground mail prices in official budgets with bibliography
features.description: Give the mail drafting agent a strict application-side searchOfficialBudgets tool and preserve the exact official version used as an internal source for each draft revision.
acceptance: searchOfficialBudgets accepts structured service, frequency, visits, hours, employees, and product criteria and searches only active official-budget versions

The tool distinguishes exact, partial, ambiguous, incomplete, and no-result searches; when products are unspecified it returns both applicable options and when evidence is insufficient Luna asks for missing data instead of inventing a price
Structured results include net, IVA, final and hourly prices, monthly workload, conditions, official-budget identity, immutable version, and calculation metadata
Each draft revision records its official-budget version through a durable source relation and renders an internal bibliography that never becomes part of the customer email
The source detail exposes the generator origin, frequency, 4.32 calculation when applicable, products, prices, version, and use date even if the official budget is later archived

Manual edits that make a quoted amount disagree with its source show a clear warning; price replies may be automated only through a confirmed matching rule with official source grounding, while ungrounded prices and other sensitive topics remain ineligible

Focused exact, partial, ambiguous, missing-data, no-invention, historical-source, mismatch, and automation-exclusion checks plus Prisma, TypeScript, lint, build, and authenticated browser evidence are recorded

features.name: mail_conversational_draft_editor
features.title: Add conversational draft editing and explicit feedback
features.description: Replace the rigid one-shot mail suggestion flow with versioned Luna revisions, direct manual editing, and feedback controls that distinguish usefulness, copying, external use, and sending.
acceptance: Administrators can edit subject and body directly, ask Luna for a specific revision, review version history, and restore an earlier version without Luna overwriting manual text silently
Draft conversation state and revisions are stored in the application database while OpenAI requests keep store false and receive only the history needed for the current revision
Sirve records positive usefulness without sending or creating an automation rule, No sirve records a reason and optional comment, and Copiar has no implicit approval or sent meaning
Guardar, Envié por mi cuenta, and Responder desde Bambú remain distinct audited outcomes tied to the exact draft version used
Official-budget bibliography stays attached per revision and remains visible while conversational or manual edits continue
Perfecta: automatizar similares remains a separate explicit confirmation and official-price grounding, attachment, safety, sender, recipient, and protected-literal guardrails still apply

Focused revision, restore, manual-edit, feedback, copy, external-use, send, source-preservation, and automation-separation checks plus Prisma, TypeScript, lint, build, and authenticated responsive browser evidence are recorded

features.name: ops_visual_foundation_daily_dashboard
features.title: Create the operations visual foundation and daily dashboard
features.description: Reduce decorative green borders and shadows, establish accessible operations tokens, and reorganize the dashboard around the administrator's daily work.
acceptance: Shared --ops-* tokens define canvas, surfaces, neutral borders, text, bamboo interaction colors, attention, focus, radii, and elevation for light and dark themes
Static panels and toolbars use neutral borders or spacing without permanent decorative shadows, and nested content avoids double-card borders
Primary buttons use one solid bamboo treatment without gradients, secondary and ghost actions are visually distinct, and each section exposes at most one primary action
The dashboard shows today's actionable visits and coordination work before monthly summaries and profitability, including useful content in the first 390x844 viewport
Related metrics are grouped by meaning instead of rendered as equal-priority cards
Dashboard sections expose retryable errors without presenting failed queries as real zero values
Contrast, visible focus, 44-pixel touch targets, light and dark themes, lint, build when available, and authenticated desktop/mobile browser smoke are recorded

features.name: ops_contextual_period_locale
features.title: Make operations period controls contextual and localize dates
features.description: Show the monthly period control only where it affects data, remove duplicate calendar navigation, and make operational dates consistently Spanish for Uruguay.
acceptance: OpsPeriodControl is rendered only on routes or sections whose data depends on the selected month and Employees does not show an irrelevant period selector
Visits has one coherent monthly navigation instead of a global month input plus separate calendar navigation
The selected period is synchronized with the URL where it improves navigation, sharing, or return behavior
The document language, calendar locale, month labels, weekdays, and week start use es-UY conventions
Visits selects today by default in the current month and uses the first visible day only for another month
Desktop and 390x844 browser smoke confirms no duplicated controls, overflow, or English date labels

features.name: ops_visits_guided_workflow
features.title: Guide visit planning and completion workflows
features.description: Simplify Visits filters and separate scheduling intent from completion intent without changing the approved occurrence data model or behavior.
acceptance: Calendar remains the initial Visits view and Cards is presented to users as Tarjetas
Mobile keeps quick filter chips visible and moves advanced filters into a sheet without hiding active-filter state or clear-all
JobOccurrenceDialog exposes explicit schedule and complete intents while persisting through the existing occurrence contracts
Creating or editing a visit below the md breakpoint opens a shadcn bottom Sheet matching the Visits filter sheet, while desktop uses a centered dialog

The visit sheet has a rounded top, bounded viewport height, safe-area padding, an internally scrollable form body, and a stable action footer with Cancelar, Guardar visita, and the existing confirmed delete flow when editing
Dialog and sheet presentations share one occurrence form, state initialization, validation, submit, and remove behavior so responsive rendering cannot change persistence outcomes
Separate date and time inputs, automatic end-date copy, four status cards, and the current archived-assigned-employee behavior are preserved
The exact-date filter remains available only in List and Tarjetas views
Loading, error, retry, empty, long-dialog, keyboard, desktop, and 390x844 browser states are verified

features.name: ops_coordination_lists
features.title: Turn jobs and employees into coordination-first lists
features.description: Make Jobs and Employees faster to scan by prioritizing the next operational action, shared query state, responsive density, and explicit failures.
acceptance: Jobs and Employees share an OpsQueryState contract for search, filters, active chips, URL behavior, and clear state
Search feedback begins after approximately 350 milliseconds rather than the current long delay
Desktop uses compact scannable rows and mobile uses compact cards without horizontal overflow
Jobs prioritize next occurrence, team coverage, attention, and profitability while Employees prioritize status, next assignment, and contact details
Each record exposes one primary action and moves secondary actions into an accessible overflow menu
The jobs list DTO provides nextOccurrence and activeAssignmentCount without per-row queries
Loading, retryable error, true empty, filtered empty, lint, build when available, and authenticated responsive browser smoke are recorded

features.name: ops_finance_task_navigation
features.title: Organize Finance around the active task
features.description: Replace the long all-sections Finance page with direct section navigation and contextual actions while preserving established calculations and list behavior.
acceptance: Finance shows one active Summary, Profitability, Receivables, Costs, or Payroll section at a time with desktop tabs and a mobile-native selector
Existing hashes or equivalent direct links open the requested Finance section and browser back or forward navigation remains coherent
Each section exposes one contextual primary action and cost configuration remains a secondary action
Internal list scrolling, status badges, and the local Profitability collapse behavior are preserved
Operational cost categories and settings are read without upserts or other writes, using explicit initialization or a non-mutating fallback
Financial rules, calculations, permissions, and persistence contracts do not change
Loading, retryable error, empty, direct-link, keyboard, desktop, and 390x844 browser states plus lint and build when available are verified

features.name: ops_visits_mobile_controls_compaction
features.title: Compact Visits controls and cards on mobile
features.description: Keep the monthly selector usable above Visits, move the remaining mobile filters into a bottom sheet, and compact visit summaries without changing operational behavior.
acceptance: The monthly selector remains visible above Visits and fits one 390-pixel-wide row without horizontal overflow
Mobile Visits shows the result count and active chips outside a shadcn bottom sheet containing the contextual filters, clear-all, and close actions
Desktop keeps the expanded filter fields and existing monthly selector presentation
Exact-date filtering remains available only in List and Cards views and all filters continue to apply immediately
Visits, Realizadas, and Pendientes render as one compact horizontal mobile row while larger breakpoints keep the current metric cards
Calendar agenda cards show the planned time once and strengthen the employee label without changing its color
Harness, lint, and authenticated 390x844 plus desktop browser smoke are recorded

features.name: ops_searchable_entity_selects
features.title: Add search to long operational selectors
features.description: Provide one shared shadcn searchable selector for long entity lists across Operations without changing short enumerated selects or data contracts.
acceptance: A shared single-value SearchableSelect uses the existing shadcn Popover and Command primitives with keyboard navigation, empty feedback, and a bounded scroll area
Search is case- and accent-insensitive and matches the visible entity label without changing stored values
Long job, employee, and cost-category selectors across Visits, Finance, assignments, and employee visit history use the shared control
Special choices such as Todos, Sin asignar, and Sin trabajo remain selectable while short status and frequency selectors remain unchanged
The searchable control works inside the mobile Visits filter bottom sheet and in desktop forms without horizontal overflow
Harness, lint, Prisma validation, and authenticated desktop plus 390x844 browser smoke are recorded
